data.subject: Public-record research for SummerHaven
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in BMRC and MRBK.

BMRC disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filed October 16, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403475/000140347526000041/bmrc-20261016.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records, including permits, agendas, call reports, and filings, with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
